newsitem.title: USA: Proler starts litigation vs partner Hugo Neu.
newsitem.headline: Proler starts litigation vs partner Hugo Neu.

text.p: Proler International Corp said Thursday it had started litigation against its scrap metals partner, Hugo Neu Corp, for interfering with Proler's merger agreement with Schnitzer Steel Industries Inc.

Separately, Hugo Neu issued a statement saying it recently obtained a temporary restraining order in New York State Supreme Court prohibiting Proler from disclosing confidential business information to Schnitzer.
Proler said it initiated litigation after learning of the temporary restraining order, which it said appears to undermine its merger agreement with Schnitzer.
Earlier this month Schnitzer and Proler signed a definitive agreement for Schnitzer to buy Proler for $7.50 per share.
At the time, Proler said it told its shareholders that it had rejected an offer from Hugo Neu, its partner in three scrap metals joint ventures, to buy Proler's interests in the ventures.
Hugo Neu said it considers Schnitzer a competitor of its scrap metal business with Proler and that a hearing has been scheduled for October 2 to look at its request for an injunction.
